analogy.rationale: Transferase inhibitors are a broad, heterogeneous class with no annotated targets, so responses will vary and be generally weak; the most similar reference classes are other kinase/transferase inhibitors that share nucleotide-binding pocket pharmacology, while methyltransferases are only distantly related.
